jobs.occupation: Seasonal Worker Wanted – Pumpkin Season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

• 
You must be at least 18 years old.

• 
EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

• 
Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

• 
Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

• 
A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

• 
Be reliable and arrive on time.

• 
Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

• 
Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

• 
Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

• 
Please remember to bring:

• 
Sleeping bag

• 
Warm clothing

• 
Practical work clothes

• 
Boots and waterproof clothing

• 
Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

• 
A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

• 
A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

• 
Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

• 
Tax Information 2026

• 
You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

• 
If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

• 
If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

• 
Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.occupation: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
jobs.employer_name: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

• 
Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

• 
Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

• 
Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

• 
Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

• 
Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

• 
Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

• 
Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

• 
Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

• 
Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

• 
Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

• 
Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

• 
Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

• 
Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

• 
Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

• 
Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

• 
Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

• 
A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

• 
Strong quantitative and analytical skills

• 
A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

• 
Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

• 
The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

• 
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills

• 
Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

• 
Previous HR experience

• 
Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

• 
Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

• 
Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

• 
Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

• 
Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

• 
Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

• 
Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

• 
Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

• 
Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

• 
Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

• 
Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

• 
Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

• 
Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

• 
Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

• 
Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

• 
Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

• 
Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.occupation: General Manager - Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Diamond Slice — General Manager (Fuldtid / Full-time)

Arbejdssted / Location: Blågårds Plads & Tagensvej, 2200 København N

Stillingstype / Position: Fastansættelse, fuldtid / Permanent, full-time

Ansøgningsfrist / Deadline: Snarest muligt / As soon as possible

Sprog / Languages: Dansk & Engelsk (se nedenfor / see English version below)

DANSK VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Trives du i en tempofyldt gæstfrihedskultur, elsker du surdejspizza på højeste niveau, og har du den operationelle rygrad til at drive et hurtigtvoksende restaurantbrand?

Siden åbningen på Blågårds Plads har Diamond Slice redefineret New York-style pizza i København. Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Nøgleområder og ansvarsopgaver

• 
Forretningsdrift & systemer:

• 
Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

• 
Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

• 
Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

• 
Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

• 
FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

• 
Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

• 
Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

• 
Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

• 
Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

• 
Catering, festivaler & vækst:

• 
Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

• 
Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

• 
Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

• 
Økonomistyring & rapportering:

• 
Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

• 
Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

• 
Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

• 
Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

• 
Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

• 
Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

• 
Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

• 
En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

• 
Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

• 
En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

• 
En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

• 
Business Operations & Systems:

• 
Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

• 
Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

• 
Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

• 
Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

• 
FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

• 
Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

• 
Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

• 
Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

• 
Catering, Festivals & Growth:

• 
Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

• 
Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

• 
Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

• 
Financial Control & Reporting:

• 
Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

• 
Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

• 
Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

• 
Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

• 
Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

• 
Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

• 
A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

• 
Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

• 
A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

• 
Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

• 
A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• 
Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

• 
Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

• 
Quality assurance and photographic documentation

• 
Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

• 
Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

• 
Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

• 
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

• 
Registering and managing additional works and variations

Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

The ability to communicate in English is important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but Danish does not need to be your native language.

At DK TØMRER, you will become part of a growing company with short decision-making processes and the opportunity to take on significant responsibility.

An exciting position involving a variety of construction projects

jobs.occupation: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

• 
Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

• 
Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

• 
Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

• 
Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

• 
Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

• 
Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

• 
Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

• 
Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

• 
Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

• 
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

• 
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• 
A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

• 
Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

• 
Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

• 
Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

• 
Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

• 
Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

• 
A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

• 
Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.

    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
